[short] skip

env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm

# A default reactor omits the source-action ID.
go build -buildmode=c-shared -o reactor.wasm main.go
go tool buildid reactor.wasm
! stdout .

# Explicit linker IDs, including an empty one, remain effective.
go build -buildmode=c-shared -ldflags=-buildid=explicit-reactor-id -o reactor.wasm main.go
go tool buildid reactor.wasm
stdout '^explicit-reactor-id$'
go build -buildmode=c-shared -ldflags=-buildid= -o reactor.wasm main.go
go tool buildid reactor.wasm
! stdout .

# Executable Wasm retains its automatic source-action ID.
go build -o executable.wasm main.go
go tool buildid executable.wasm
stdout .

-- main.go --
package main

//go:wasmexport ping
func ping() uint32 { return 7 }

func main() {}
